title: AIxDaily
overview_zh: 今日精选呈现“科研预印本与工具动态并行”的格局：化学侧聚焦新抗原排序和抗菌肽预测，生物侧涵盖肿瘤表观治疗、显性遗传病编辑及阿尔茨海默病单核图谱，均为预印本，尚待同行评议与独立验证。AI Voices 同时收录第三方预发布评测、研究者公开观点和模型方官方发布；工程频道则是 GitHub Trending 的开源项目快照，不能等同于软件正式发布。数学频道今日没有足够高质量更新。

channel_highlights.aixchem: 两篇精选均为预印本：DeepPROTECTNeo 将 TCR 结合纳入新抗原排序，TabPFN 以序列特征改进抗菌肽多活性预测；临床与实验泛化仍待验证。
channel_highlights.aixbio: 三篇精选均为预印本：从延长 G1 期与 LSD1 抑制的肿瘤治疗窗口，到显性遗传病等位基因编辑和 AD 单核图谱，证据尚未形成临床结论。
channel_highlights.aixmath: 今日没有足够高质量更新：尽管完成候选筛选，但没有项目达到入选门槛，故不以数量填补栏目。
channel_highlights.aivoices: 重点包括 Epoch AI 对 GPT-6 Astra 的第三方预发布评测、研究负责人的公开风险观点与 OpenAI 官方模型发布；三者均不构成同行评议论文。
channel_highlights.engineering: 三项均为 GitHub Trending 开源项目快照，包括写作技能、本地科研工作台和跨平台转写工具；热度与仓库描述不等同于软件发布或性能验证。

breaking_news.headline_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra，并上线 GPT-6 Pro
breaking_news.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra，称其为新一代智能模型，重点覆盖计算机操作、编程、网络安全与科学任务；该模型已通过 GPT-6 Pro 向 Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 用户提供。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 这是前沿实验室的旗舰能力发布，并直接进入产品层。若其跨工具操作与科研能力兑现，将改变高复杂度知识工作和智能体工程的可用边界。

breaking_news.headline_zh: Anthropic 报告 Claude 用 11 天自主形式化费马大定理证明
breaking_news.summary_zh: Anthropic 报告称，Claude 在约 11 天内大体自主地将费马大定理的既有证明写成 Lean 形式化证明。该工作没有提出费马大定理的新解法，而是推进了对其完整机器可检验证明的构建。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 费马大定理是数学史上最著名的问题之一；把成熟证明转化为大规模、可机器核验的形式体系，是 AI 进入严谨数学工程的重要能力跃迁。

breaking_news.headline_zh: Allen AI 公布大气—海洋耦合气候模拟器 SamudrACE-E3SMv3
breaking_news.summary_zh: Allen AI 与 E3SM 团队公布 SamudrACE-E3SMv3：将大气与海洋机器学习模拟器耦合，使二者在运行中相互反馈。其报告称，单张 H100 每天可模拟约 1,100 年气候，而 E3SM 约需 105 个节点模拟 28 年。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 它把长期耦合地球系统模拟从大规模超算工作负载压缩到单 GPU 量级，若稳定性与极端事件表现经受检验，可扩大气候情景筛选和集合模拟的可及性。

items.title: DeepPROTECTNeo: A Context-aware Personalized and Reverse Vaccinology-guided Deep Learning Framework for Immunogenicity Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Background: The development of personalized cancer vaccines relies on accurately identifying neoepitopes capable of eliciting strong immune responses. T cell receptor (TCR)-epitope interactions are fundamental to cancer immunotherapy. Traditional computational approaches focus primarily on epitope-major histocompatibility complex (MHC) binding, often overlooking the critical contribution of TCR binding. Furthermore, the clinical applicability of existing methods is constrained by fragmented pipelines that require separate workflows for variant calling, HLA typing, and independent peptide-MHC (pMHC) or peptide-TCR (pTCR) evaluation stages. Results: We present DeepPROTECTNeo, a unified deep learning framework that integrates genomic variant detection, HLA typing, high-affinity pMHC binding prediction, variant-driven TCR repertoire mining, followed by a hybrid transformer-Convolutional Neural Network dual-branch feature extractor with an explicit cross-attention-based deep learning model for TCR-epitope binding prediction. Our reverse vaccinology-inspired biologically informed architecture integrates Bidirectional Long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) sequence features, convolutional-attention physicochemical/evolutionary descriptors via gated fusion, and TCR numbered contextual embeddings to enable residue-level interpretable modelling. Under a strict TCR-split strategy, it achieved a mean AUROC of 0.7856 and AUPRC of 0.7932 outperforming six state-of-the-art predictors by 4-5% with tight inter-fold stability. The architecture maintains high robustness against structural hard negatives and imbalanced datasets, successfully recovering 18 of 34 validated high-affinity neoepitopes from a patient-specific cancer cohort. Conclusions: Experiments results demonstrate that DeepPROTECTNeo is a powerful, reliable end-to-end neoantigen prioritization framework that effectively models complex TCR-epitope interfaces directly from clinical sequencing data, providing a robust interpretable foundation to accelerate personalized cancer immunotherapy.
items.summary_zh: DeepPROTECTNeo 将变异检测、HLA 分型、pMHC 亲和力预测、TCR 谱挖掘和 TCR–表位结合预测串为端到端个体化新抗原优选流程；在严格 TCR 划分下报告 AUROC 0.7856、AUPRC 0.7932，并在患者队列中找回34个已验证高亲和力新表位中的18个。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把 TCR 结合而非仅 pMHC 结合纳入新抗原排序，契合个体化癌症疫苗的关键生物学约束，并提供了患者队列层面的验证信号。该工作仍为预印本；临床获益、不同队列与 HLA 背景中的泛化能力，以及各上游预测环节误差的累积影响，尚需独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：个体化癌症疫苗的开发依赖于准确识别能够诱发强免疫应答的新表位。T 细胞受体（TCR）–表位相互作用是癌症免疫治疗的基础。传统计算方法主要聚焦于表位–主要组织相容性复合体（MHC）结合，往往忽视 TCR 结合的关键贡献。此外，现有方法的临床适用性受制于碎片化流程：变异检测、HLA 分型以及独立的肽–MHC（pMHC）或肽–TCR（pTCR）评估阶段需要分别开展。结果：我们提出 DeepPROTECTNeo，这是一种统一的深度学习框架，整合基因组变异检测、HLA 分型、高亲和力 pMHC 结合预测、由变异驱动的 TCR 库挖掘，随后使用混合 Transformer–Convolutional Neural Network 双分支特征提取器，以及用于 TCR–表位结合预测的显式基于交叉注意力的深度学习模型。我们受逆向疫苗学启发、具有生物学信息的架构整合了 Bidirectional Long short-term memory（Bi-LSTM）序列特征、经门控融合的卷积–注意力物理化学/进化描述符，以及 TCR 编号上下文嵌入，以实现残基层面的可解释建模。在严格 TCR 划分策略下，该模型获得平均 AUROC 0.7856 和 AUPRC 0.7932，以4–5%的幅度优于六个最先进预测器，且跨折稳定性很高。该架构对结构性困难负例和类别不平衡数据集保持较高鲁棒性，并成功从患者特异性癌症队列中找回34个已验证高亲和力新表位中的18个。结论：实验结果表明，DeepPROTECTNeo 是一种强大、可靠的端到端新抗原优选框架，可直接从临床测序数据中有效建模复杂的 TCR–表位界面，为加速个体化癌症免疫治疗提供了稳健且可解释的基础。

items.title: Coarse composition suffices: tabular in-context learning for multi-activity antimicrobial peptide profiling
items.abstract_or_text: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) often act against multiple pathogen classes, making multi-label activity prediction a more realistic screening target than binary antimicrobial classification. The ESCAPE benchmark formalizes this setting, but leading approaches typically rely on multimodal, structure-conditioned deep models that are costly to train and tune. We show that a simple, sequence-only pipeline can match and surpass these methods by combining 330 interpretable sequence descriptors with TabPFN, a tabular foundation model that performs in-context prediction in a single forward pass without gradient-based training or hyperparameter search. On ESCAPE (82,359 peptides; five labels), a label-powerset TabPFN model achieves mAP-5=77.8%, improving on the previously best reported 72.1%. A probabilistic classifier chain is the first method to match or exceed the best published average precision on each of the five labels simultaneously. The gains persist under the prior state-of-the-art single-fold training protocol, indicating they are not a training-set-size artefact, and are largest for remote homologues (+11.2 points below 30% sequence identity). Ablations further show that predicted structure is unnecessary at inference and that performance is not driven by any single descriptor family: ten global physicochemical scalars recover 91% of full-feature performance. Finally, explicitly modelling label dependence yields targeted benefits for scarce activities and supports ranking which activity to assay next from partial positive evidence.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以330个可解释的序列描述符和 TabPFN 构建无需梯度训练的多标签抗菌肽活性预测流程。在 ESCAPE 的82,359条肽、5个标签上，模型达到 mAP-5=77.8%，并通过消融显示少量全局理化特征已可恢复大部分性能，尤其改善远缘同源肽的预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果提示抗菌肽多活性筛选未必依赖昂贵的结构条件深度模型，为低成本、可解释的候选排序与后续测定规划提供了基线。证据目前来自单一基准及既有单折协议，尚不等同于对新肽的前瞻性实验验证或药代、安全性与成药性评估。
items.abstract_zh: 抗菌肽（AMP）通常可作用于多类病原体，因此多标签活性预测比二元抗菌分类更符合实际筛选目标。ESCAPE 基准将这一任务形式化，但领先方法通常依赖多模态、结构条件化的深度模型，其训练和调参成本很高。我们表明，一个简单的仅序列流程可通过结合330个可解释的序列描述符与 TabPFN——一种无需基于梯度的训练或超参数搜索、可在单次前向传播中进行上下文内预测的表格基础模型——匹配并超越这些方法。在 ESCAPE（82,359条肽；五个标签）上，标签幂集 TabPFN 模型取得 mAP-5=77.8%，优于此前报道的最佳结果72.1%。概率分类器链是首个能同时达到或超过五个标签中每一个标签已发表最佳平均精确率的方法。增益在此前最先进的单折训练协议下仍然存在，说明这并非训练集规模造成的假象；对于远缘同源序列，增益最大（序列同一性低于30%时提高11.2个点）。消融实验进一步表明，推理时不需要预测结构，且性能并非由任何单一描述符家族驱动：十个全局物理化学标量即可恢复完整特征性能的91%。最后，显式建模标签依赖性可为稀缺活性带来有针对性的收益，并支持根据部分阳性证据对下一项应检测的活性进行排序。

items.title: Cell cycle control of chromatin creates a therapeutic window for epigenetic therapy in tumors
items.abstract_or_text: The relationship between cell cycle length and differentiation competence is well established in developmental biology, particularly in embryonic stem cells, where a short G1 phase maintains pluripotency and G1 lengthening permits lineage commitment. Whether this principle operates in cancer cells, where the cell cycle is deregulated and G1 is frequently shortened, and whether it can be pharmacologically exploited for therapy, has not been tested. Here we show that the duration of G1 is a causal determinant of chromatin state in cancer cells and that extending G1 creates a therapeutic window for epigenetic drugs. Using acute myeloid leukemia (AML) as a model, we demonstrate that low-dose palbociclib, at concentrations well below those required for cytostatic arrest, extends G1 without halting proliferation. This modest prolongation reshapes the histone modification landscape: repressive marks (H3K9me2/3, H4K20me2/3) increase while acetylation decreases, and chromatin accessibility rises broadly in the euchromatic compartment. Naturally slow-cycling AML lines share this epigenetic signature regardless of their oncogenic driver mutations, and pharmacologically extending G1 in fast-cycling cells recapitulates it, establishing G1 length as a causal regulator of the cancer epigenome rather than a passive correlate. To identify epigenetic vulnerabilities created by G1 extension, we performed complementary drug and CRISPR-Cas9 screens in G1-extended AML cells. Both approaches converged on LSD1 (KDM1A): slow-cycling AML cells are intrinsically sensitive to LSD1 inhibition, while fast-cycling cells become sensitive when G1 is prolonged. The combination of low-dose palbociclib and LSD1 inhibition triggers differentiation and significantly prolongs survival in AML xenograft models. p21 (CDKN1A) emerges as the central molecular determinant of this response. In slow-cycling AML cells, p21 is highly expressed and its knockdown abolishes LSD1 inhibitor sensitivity. Structure-function analysis using p21 mutants separates the two known activities of p21: the CDK-inhibitory function (which extends G1) is required for sensitization, whereas the PCNA-binding function is dispensable. Three pharmacological routes converge on the same endpoint, CDK inhibition, G1 extension, and a differentiation-competent chromatin state: direct CDK4/6 inhibition by palbociclib, p21 overexpression, and p21 induction through HDAC or EZH1/2 inhibitors. Palbociclib bypasses the requirement for p21 entirely, confirming that G1 length itself, not p21 as a protein, is the critical variable. Mechanistically, the combination of G1 extension and LSD1 inhibition produces a qualitatively distinct chromatin state rather than an additive one. ATAC-seq reveals thousands of combination-exclusive accessible regions, enriched for footprints of myeloid differentiation transcription factors including SPI1/PU.1, IRF1, and STAT1/2. A double-lock principle governs this remodeling: palbociclib drives the removal of repressive marks (H3K9me3 and H3K27me3), while LSD1 inhibition installs active marks at the newly accessible regions. The ncBAF chromatin remodeling complex, identified in our CRISPR screen and validated by knockout of its essential subunits BRD9 and SMARCD1, is specifically required for this response. Loss of ncBAF abolishes the combination-induced chromatin remodeling and differentiation program but does not affect the initial G1 extension or retinoic acid-induced differentiation, indicating that ncBAF specifically couples cell-cycle modulation to chromatin remodeling rather than acting as a general differentiation factor. The principle generalizes beyond AML. In melanoma, breast cancer, and small-cell lung cancer (SCLC), sensitivity to LSD1 inhibition tracks with p21 expression and cycling speed. Primary melanoma samples stratified by p21 recapitulate the same pattern: p21-high, slow-cycling cells are sensitive; p21-low, fast-cycling cells are resistant but can be sensitized by palbociclib cotreatment. Cisplatin-induced drug-tolerant persister (DTP) cells, which emerge as a slow-cycling, chemo-resistant population and upregulate both p21 and LSD1, become vulnerable to LSD1 inhibition and are eradicated by the combination. In melanoma patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models, p21-high tumors respond to LSD1 inhibitor monotherapy, while p21-low tumors are sensitized by palbociclib cotreatment, with p21 knockdown abolishing the response. Together, these findings establish cell-cycle duration as a tunable regulator of the cancer epigenome and demonstrate that pharmacological G1 extension converts cytostatic CDK4/6 inhibition into an epigenetic sensitization strategy. Both fast-proliferating and slow-cycling tumor compartments (including drug-resistant persisters) can be targeted by matching the epigenomic state to the appropriate combination of cell-cycle modulators and epigenetic drugs. p21 emerges as a candidate biomarker for patient stratification. More broadly, our work repositions the cell cycle from a passive conduit for proliferation signals to an active, druggable regulator of chromatin fate, with implications that extend from cancer therapy to stem cell biology and regenerative medicine.
items.summary_zh: 研究以 AML 为模型，提出延长 G1 期可重塑染色质状态，并通过药物与 CRISPR-Cas9 筛选确定 LSD1 抑制是该状态下的脆弱性；联合低剂量 palbociclib 与 LSD1 抑制剂在异种移植模型中延长生存。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将细胞周期动力学、染色质可塑性和表观遗传治疗连接起来，并给出跨癌种、CRISPR 和 PDX 层面的预印本证据；p21 作为分层标志物仍需前瞻性临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞周期长度与分化能力之间的关系在发育生物学中已得到充分确立，尤其是在胚胎干细胞中：短 G1 期维持多能性，而 G1 延长允许谱系承诺。这一原则是否也适用于细胞周期失调且 G1 经常缩短的癌细胞，以及能否通过药理学手段将其用于治疗，尚未经过检验。本文表明，G1 持续时间是癌细胞染色质状态的因果决定因素，延长 G1 会为表观遗传药物创造治疗窗口。以急性髓系白血病（AML）为模型，研究显示远低于引起细胞抑制性停滞所需浓度的低剂量 palbociclib 可在不中止增殖的情况下延长 G1。这种适度延长重塑了组蛋白修饰图谱：抑制性标记（H3K9me2/3、H4K20me2/3）增加，乙酰化减少，而常染色质区室的染色质可及性广泛升高。天然慢周期 AML 细胞系不论其致癌驱动突变为何，均具有这一表观遗传特征；在快周期细胞中以药理学方式延长 G1 可重现该特征，表明 G1 长度是癌症表观基因组的因果调节因子，而非被动相关因素。为识别由 G1 延长产生的表观遗传脆弱性，研究在 G1 延长的 AML 细胞中进行了互补的药物和 CRISPR-Cas9 筛选。两种方法均指向 LSD1（KDM1A）：慢周期 AML 细胞对 LSD1 抑制具有内在敏感性，而快周期细胞在 G1 延长后变得敏感。低剂量 palbociclib 与 LSD1 抑制的组合诱导分化，并在 AML 异种移植模型中显著延长生存期。p21（CDKN1A）成为该反应的核心分子决定因素。在慢周期 AML 细胞中，p21 高表达，其敲低会消除对 LSD1 抑制剂的敏感性。利用 p21 突变体的结构—功能分析区分了 p21 已知的两项活性：CDK 抑制功能（延长 G1）是敏化所必需的，而 PCNA 结合功能则非必需。三种药理学途径汇聚至同一终点：CDK 抑制、G1 延长和具备分化能力的染色质状态，分别为 palbociclib 对 CDK4/6 的直接抑制、p21 过表达，以及通过 HDAC 或 EZH1/2 抑制剂诱导 p21。Palbociclib 完全绕过了对 p21 的需求，证实关键变量是 G1 长度本身，而不是 p21 作为一种蛋白。机制上，G1 延长与 LSD1 抑制的组合产生的是一种在性质上不同而非相加的染色质状态。ATAC-seq 揭示数千个仅见于联合处理的开放区域，其中富集髓系分化转录因子，包括 SPI1/PU.1、IRF1 和 STAT1/2 的足迹。一项“双锁”原则调控这一重塑：palbociclib 促进抑制性标记（H3K9me3 和 H3K27me3）的去除，而 LSD1 抑制在新开放区域安装活性标记。研究的 CRISPR 筛选识别出 ncBAF 染色质重塑复合体，并通过其必需亚基 BRD9 和 SMARCD1 的敲除进行验证；该复合体对此反应具有特异性要求。失去 ncBAF 会消除联合处理诱导的染色质重塑和分化程序，却不影响初始 G1 延长或视黄酸诱导的分化，说明 ncBAF 特异性地将细胞周期调控与染色质重塑耦联，而不是作为一般性的分化因子。该原则可推广至 AML 之外。在黑色素瘤、乳腺癌和小细胞肺癌（SCLC）中，对 LSD1 抑制的敏感性随 p21 表达和细胞周期速度而变化。原代黑色素瘤样本按 p21 分层后重现相同模式：p21-high、慢周期细胞敏感；p21-low、快周期细胞耐药，但可由 palbociclib 联用实现敏化。由顺铂诱导的耐药持续细胞（DTP）是一类慢周期、化疗耐药细胞，会上调 p21 和 LSD1；其对 LSD1 抑制变得脆弱，并可被该联合方案清除。在黑色素瘤患者来源异种移植（PDX）模型中，p21-high 肿瘤对 LSD1 抑制剂单药有反应，而 p21-low 肿瘤可被 palbociclib 联用敏化，且 p21 敲低会消除反应。综上，这些发现将细胞周期持续时间确立为癌症表观基因组的可调节因子，并显示以药理方式延长 G1 可将细胞抑制性的 CDK4/6 抑制转变为一种表观遗传敏化策略。通过使表观基因组状态与适当的细胞周期调节剂和表观遗传药物组合相匹配，可以靶向快速增殖和慢周期肿瘤区室（包括耐药持续细胞）。p21 成为患者分层的候选生物标志物。更广泛地说，本研究将细胞周期从增殖信号的被动通路重新定位为染色质命运的主动、可药物靶向的调节因子，其意义延伸至癌症治疗、干细胞生物学和再生医学。

items.title: Common variant-based genome editing to address the heterogeneity of pathogenic variants in dominant disorders
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract There are approximately 2,000 known autosomal dominant disorders, which collectively represent a substantial medical burden. CRISPR-Cas9–based genome editing offers a promising route toward disease-modifying therapies that correct or disrupt pathogenic alleles. However, the extensive heterogeneity of pathogenic variants within individual disease genes remains a major barrier to clinical translation. To address this challenge, we developed “ COVER ” ( CO mmon V ariants-assisted genome- E diting R emedy), a mutation-independent, allele-specific, genome-editing framework. COVER leverages pairs of heterozygous common variants in cis with pathogenic variants to selectively inactivate the mutant allele, either by deleting exons whose removal induces a frameshift or by deleting the region containing the start codon. This strategy avoids the need to target each pathogenic variant individually. A systematic analysis of autosomal dominant disorder genes showed that COVER is applicable to 902 causal genes, achieving a median estimated patient coverage of 46.3%, which represents a 2.3-fold increase compared with targeting the most frequent pathogenic variant in each gene. Using patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cells, we experimentally validated COVER in two disease-causing genes: APP in familial Alzheimer’s disease and GFAP in Alexander disease. In both models, COVER effectively inactivated the mutant allele and alleviated key pathological hallmarks in corresponding brain cell types. To facilitate broader application, we developed a web-based platform for screening common variant pairs in genes of interest. Together, these findings establish COVER as a generalized genome-editing strategy for autosomal dominant disorders, offering broad estimated patient coverage and advancing the therapeutic potential of allele-specific genome editing.
items.summary_zh: COVER 利用与致病变异顺式连锁的杂合常见变异，选择性失活显性遗传病的突变等位基因；作者估计其覆盖 902 个致病基因，并在 APP 与 GFAP 患者来源 iPSC 模型中验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本以共同遗传背景替代逐变异定制编辑，兼具广泛覆盖估计与患者来源细胞实验；其治疗安全性、递送和长期疗效尚未在人体中证实。
items.abstract_zh: 已知约有 2,000 种常染色体显性遗传病，它们共同构成了沉重的医疗负担。基于 CRISPR-Cas9 的基因组编辑为校正或破坏致病等位基因提供了通向疾病修饰治疗的有前景路径。然而，单个疾病基因内致病变异的广泛异质性仍是临床转化的主要障碍。为应对这一挑战，我们开发了“COVER”（COmmon Variants-assisted genome-Editing Remedy），一种不依赖特定突变、具等位基因特异性的基因组编辑框架。COVER 利用与致病变异处于顺式的成对杂合常见变异，选择性地使突变等位基因失活：方法可以删除其缺失会导致移码的外显子，或删除包含起始密码子的区域。这一策略避免了必须逐一靶向每个致病变异。对常染色体显性遗传病基因的系统分析显示，COVER 适用于 902 个致病基因，估计患者覆盖率中位数为 46.3%，与靶向每个基因中最常见致病变异相比提高 2.3 倍。我们使用患者来源诱导多能干细胞，在两个致病基因中对 COVER 进行了实验验证：家族性阿尔茨海默病的 APP 和 Alexander 病的 GFAP。在两个模型中，COVER 均有效使突变等位基因失活，并减轻相应脑细胞类型中的关键病理特征。为促进更广泛应用，我们开发了一个基于网络的平台，用于筛选目标基因中的常见变异对。总之，这些发现将 COVER 确立为面向常染色体显性遗传病的通用基因组编辑策略，具有广泛的估计患者覆盖范围，并推进了等位基因特异性基因组编辑的治疗潜力。
items.author_line: Ip N, Fu Y, Duan Y, Cao H, Tsang HWS, Wong L, Ngai SY, Fu W, Fu A

items.title: An Integrated Single-Nucleus Atlas Resolves Cell-Type-Specific Programs and Molecular Subtypes in Alzheimer's Disease
items.abstract_or_text: Interindividual heterogeneity in Alzheimer's disease (AD) remains poorly understood, as disparate single-cell studies leave it unclear whether findings reflect shared architecture or dataset-specific idiosyncrasies. Here, we present panAD, a transcriptomic atlas of >3 million nuclei from 791 individuals across 13 studies, spanning AD, mild cognitive impairment, and cognitively normal aging. AD converges on a reproducible, cell-type-specific molecular architecture: co-expression modules track neuropathology and cognitive decline; GWAS risk genes act predominantly as downstream targets of transcription factor hubs such as microglial SPI1; intercellular communication is remodeled with disease stage; and sex differences concentrate in microglial immune-activation programs. To model patient-level transcriptomic heterogeneity, we developed the Multi-seed Optimization of Neural Embeddings for subTyping (MONET) framework, in which a masked variational autoencoder applied to covariate-adjusted, multi-cell-type profiles resolves four subtypes (Metal-Ion Stress, Neuroinflammatory, Synaptic Integrity, and Tissue Remodeling) that dissociate neuropathological burden from cognitive impairment and nominate predominantly non-overlapping candidate therapeutics. Finally, Stellar Atlas provides an AI-native conversational interface to the atlas.
items.summary_zh: panAD 整合 13 项研究中 791 名个体的超过 300 万个细胞核，并以 MONET 从协变量校正的多细胞类型表达谱中解析 AD 的四种分子亚型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是大规模跨研究单核图谱和患者异质性建模；四种亚型与候选疗法的对应关系来自转录组关联与模型分析，尚不是治疗效应证据。
items.abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）的个体间异质性仍缺乏理解，因为不同单细胞研究使人无法确定已有发现反映的是共同架构还是数据集特异的偶然现象。本文提出 panAD：一个转录组图谱，汇集 13 项研究中 791 名个体的超过 300 万个细胞核，涵盖 AD、轻度认知障碍和认知正常老化。AD 汇聚为一种可重复的、细胞类型特异的分子架构：共表达模块随神经病理和认知下降而变化；GWAS 风险基因主要作为小胶质细胞 SPI1 等转录因子枢纽的下游靶标发挥作用；细胞间通信随疾病阶段重塑；性别差异集中于小胶质细胞免疫激活程序。为模拟患者层面的转录组异质性，我们开发了用于分型的神经嵌入多种子优化（Multi-seed Optimization of Neural Embeddings for subTyping，MONET）框架，其中将掩码变分自编码器应用于经协变量校正的多细胞类型表达谱，解析出四种亚型（Metal-Ion Stress、Neuroinflammatory、Synaptic Integrity 和 Tissue Remodeling）；这些亚型将神经病理负担与认知损害区分开来，并提出大多彼此不重叠的候选治疗方法。最后，Stellar Atlas 为该图谱提供了 AI-native 对话式界面。
items.author_line: Rahimzadeh, N., Morabito, S., Khullar, S., Shi, Z., Cao, Z., Swarup, V.

items.title: Rapid nasal metabolism organizes the neural representation of odors
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract The olfactory system translates chemical stimuli (odorants) into neural patterns of activity that give rise to odor perception. Canonical models of odor coding consider the binding of odorants to receptors expressed on olfactory sensory neurons (OSNs) as the primary organizing step in this process 1. However, such models fail to account for key aspects of odorant-evoked responses measured in vivo. Here, we considered how a process peripheral to receptor-ligand binding - the metabolism of odorants by xenobiotic enzymes in the nasal mucosa - may impact odor codes in vivo. Using imaging in awake mice and odorants linked by well-characterized enzymatic pathways 2-4, we find that nasal metabolism rapidly generates odorous metabolites and profoundly alters odor representations over a time-scale relevant for odor perception. Rapid odorant metabolism explains what otherwise appears to be complex tuning of OSNs as well as diverse temporal response patterns not accounted for by a simple receptor-ligand model. While nasal metabolism introduces confusion between identity-based representations of inhaled versus metabolism-generated odorants, we find that inhalation-linked response timing resolves this confusion and that temporally segregated representations of inhaled versus metabolism-generated odorants are preserved at the level of olfactory bulb projections to cortex. These findings demonstrate that odorant metabolism is integral to olfactory sensation and define a novel role for timing in olfaction: to distinguish external chemical signals from those generated internally, potentially supporting distinct percepts and behavioral responses to each.
items.summary_zh: 清醒小鼠成像结合具有明确酶途径的气味分子显示，鼻黏膜代谢可迅速生成有气味代谢物，并改变嗅觉神经表征的时间结构。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本以体内实验挑战仅以受体—配体结合组织气味编码的简化模型；结果支持鼻部代谢参与嗅觉编码，但并未直接证明特定知觉或行为后果。
items.abstract_zh: 嗅觉系统将化学刺激（气味分子）转化为神经活动模式，从而产生气味知觉。气味编码的经典模型认为，与嗅觉感觉神经元（OSNs）表达的受体发生气味分子结合，是该过程的主要组织步骤 1。然而，这类模型无法解释在体内测得的气味分子诱发反应的关键方面。本文考察了一个位于受体—配体结合之外的过程——鼻黏膜中异生物酶对气味分子的代谢——如何影响体内气味编码。使用清醒小鼠成像以及由充分表征的酶促途径连接的气味分子 2-4，我们发现鼻部代谢可快速产生有气味的代谢物，并在与气味知觉相关的时间尺度上深刻改变气味表征。快速的气味分子代谢解释了原本看似复杂的 OSN 调谐，以及无法由简单受体—配体模型解释的多种时间反应模式。尽管鼻部代谢使基于身份的吸入气味分子表征与代谢产生的气味分子表征之间出现混淆，我们发现与吸入相关的反应时序可消除这一混淆；并且，在从嗅球投射至皮层的层面，吸入气味分子与代谢产生的气味分子的时间分离表征得以保留。这些发现表明，气味分子代谢是嗅觉感觉的组成部分，并界定了时序在嗅觉中的一种新作用：区分外部化学信号与内部产生的化学信号，可能支持对二者不同的知觉和行为反应。
items.author_line: Wachowiak M, Acquah E, Herrboldt M, Hallkaj J, Marie M, Wu Z, Chaloyard J, Andriot I, Heydel J, Matsunami H, Zhao K

items.title: Toward Transportable Acute Kidney Injury Prediction: An Explainable XGBoost Model with Temporal Validation Using MIMIC-IV
items.abstract_or_text: BackgroundAcute kidney injury (AKI) is a frequent complication within intensive care units, with its sudden onset often missed. Existing machine learning and deep learning models have contributed to closing this gap, but their complexity, requiring hundreds to thousands of features, and lack of generalisation pose a limitation that prevents them from being integrated into clinical workflows across different electronic health-record ecosystems. MethodsThis study presents a 37-feature XGBoost model trained on the MIMIC-IV dataset with 5.4% positive cases, with hyperparameters optimised via Optuna and probabilities calibrated using isotonic regression, designed for transportability across clinical settings. Validation was conducted internally using a temporal patient-level split simulating prospective deployment, training on 2008-2016 data and testing on 2017-2022 data. External validation was performed on the eICU Collaborative Research Database, a multi-centre dataset spanning 208 US hospitals, using the trained model without retraining. SHAP TreeExplainer was used to provide feature-level explainability for individual predictions. ResultsInternal testing yielded an AUROC score of 0.794 for predicting AKI onset within a 12-24 hour window. External validation produced a 0.750 AUROC without retraining. Equitable discrimination was observed across gender, age, chronic kidney disease presence, race, and AKI stages on both datasets, with a 95% internal CI of 0.789-0.799 confirming the models estimate stability. ConclusionThese results suggest that clinically useful prediction systems are achievable with substantially fewer features than current models require.
items.summary_zh: 一项 37 特征 XGBoost AKI 预测模型在 MIMIC-IV 的时间切分中训练和测试，并未经再训练在覆盖 208 家美国医院的 eICU 数据库中外部验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本采用时间验证、外部无再训练测试和 SHAP，可较好检验可迁移性；AUROC 仍不足以确立临床净获益或部署安全性。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：急性肾损伤（AKI）是重症监护病房中的常见并发症，其突然发生往往未被发现。现有机器学习和深度学习模型有助于弥补这一缺口，但其复杂性——需要数百至数千个特征——以及缺乏泛化能力，限制了它们在不同电子健康记录生态系统中的临床工作流整合。方法：本研究提出一个使用 37 个特征的 XGBoost 模型，在阳性病例比例为 5.4% 的 MIMIC-IV 数据集上训练；模型通过 Optuna 优化超参数，并使用保序回归校准概率，旨在实现跨临床场景的可迁移性。验证通过模拟前瞻性部署的、按患者划分的内部时间切分完成：使用 2008–2016 年数据训练，并以 2017–2022 年数据测试。外部验证在 eICU Collaborative Research Database 上完成；该多中心数据集覆盖美国 208 家医院，使用训练好的模型而不再训练。采用 SHAP TreeExplainer 为单个预测提供特征层面的可解释性。结果：在预测 12–24 小时窗口内发生 AKI 时，内部测试的 AUROC 为 0.794。未经再训练的外部验证 AUROC 为 0.750。在两个数据集中，模型对性别、年龄、是否存在慢性肾病、种族和 AKI 分期均表现出均衡的区分能力；内部 95% CI 为 0.789–0.799，证实模型估计的稳定性。结论：这些结果提示，临床上有用的预测系统可使用远少于当前模型所需的特征实现。
items.author_line: Okundaye, D. O., Isiekwene, C. C.

items.title: Prompting Beyond Pairs: Decoupled Semantic Supervision for Knowledge-Guided Multiplex Virtual Staining
items.abstract_or_text: Virtual staining provides a non-invasive alternative to fluorescence microscopy, yet existing deep learning approaches fundamentally rely on pixel-aligned, multiplexed fluorescence targets for supervision. This dependence on rigidly paired data limits scalability, constrains flexibility in generating diverse subcellular structures, and becomes impractical in data-scarce biological settings. In this work, we introduce a semantic supervision paradigm for virtual staining, demonstrating that domain-knowledge prompts can effectively replace conventional pixel-level supervision. Unlike existing methods constrained by rigidly paired multiplex targets, our framework leverages biological prompts to decouple structural guidance from image translation. This decoupling enables high-fidelity, independent synthesis of multiple subcellular structures using only single-channel data. To ensure high-fidelity generation under weak supervision, we integrate self-supervised representation learning to mitigate data scarcity and incorporate direct preference optimization to suppress structural artifacts. Evaluations on the JUMP benchmark demonstrate that our approach effectively balances flexibility and fidelity, outperforming supervised baselines with a 43.3 % reduction in Average FID and an Average PCC of 0.912, while exhibiting high robustness in channel-deficient scenarios. Furthermore, the model generalizes across four in-house datasets to successfully multiplex six subcellular structures, overcoming the physical constraints of conventional fluorescent staining.
items.summary_zh: 该方法以生物学提示替代像素对齐的多重荧光监督，在 JUMP benchmark 和四个内部数据集上进行多重虚拟染色评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它尝试解除虚拟染色对严格配对数据的依赖，并报告了跨基准与内部数据的量化结果；生成图像是否适用于具体生物学或诊断决策仍需任务级验证。
items.abstract_zh: 虚拟染色为荧光显微镜提供了一种非侵入性替代方案，但现有深度学习方法从根本上依赖像素对齐的多重荧光靶标进行监督。对严格配对数据的这种依赖限制了可扩展性，约束了生成多样化亚细胞结构的灵活性，并在生物学数据稀缺的环境中变得不切实际。本文提出一种用于虚拟染色的语义监督范式，表明领域知识提示可以有效替代传统的像素级监督。不同于受严格配对多重靶标约束的现有方法，我们的框架利用生物学提示，将结构引导与图像转换解耦。这一解耦使得仅使用单通道数据即可高保真、独立地合成多种亚细胞结构。为确保弱监督下的高保真生成，我们整合自监督表征学习以缓解数据稀缺，并引入直接偏好优化以抑制结构伪影。在 JUMP benchmark 上的评估表明，该方法能有效平衡灵活性与保真度，相较监督基线方法使 Average FID 降低 43.3 %，Average PCC 达到 0.912，并在通道缺失情形中表现出较高鲁棒性。此外，该模型可泛化至四个内部数据集，成功对六种亚细胞结构进行多重染色，从而克服常规荧光染色的物理约束。
items.author_line: Hu, Y., Wang, J., Zheng, K., Jin, Y., Yu, H.

items.title: PhysiCelldFBA: Linking single-cell genome-scale metabolism to spatially explicit multicellular dynamics
items.abstract_or_text: Genome-scale metabolic models can predict how individual cells allocate resources and respond to their environment, yet few frameworks link single-cell metabolism to the spatial organisation of multicellular systems. Here we introduce PhysiCelldFBA, an extension of the PhysiCell agent-based framework that couples genome-scale dynamic flux balance analysis to off-lattice multicellular simulations. Each simulated cell carries its own metabolic model, allowing local environmental conditions to shape metabolism while metabolic activity feeds back on the surrounding environment, cellular behaviour, and spatial organisation. We first validate this coupling by showing that glucose consumption, CO2 production, and biomass accumulation remain mass-balanced in a closed E. coli system, with simulated biomass agreeing with analytical predictions to within 1%. We then demonstrate how metabolic phenotypes emerge from this coupling across microbial and mammalian systems. Spatial nutrient gradients generate metabolic stratification and acetate cross-feeding in growing E. coli colonies; diffusion-limited metabolism produces proliferative, hypoxic, and necrotic zones across a broad panel of metabolites in a tumour-like tissue; distinct, organism-specific metabolic networks give rise to syntrophic cross-feeding and spatial niche formation in a two-species consortium; and metabolic state couples energy availability to transitions between cellular motility and growth. Across these examples, metabolic stratification, cross-feeding, and phenotypic adaptation emerge from local metabolic optimisation and environmental feedback rather than being explicitly prescribed. PhysiCelldFBA therefore provides a general framework for simulating genome-scale metabolism at single-cell resolution and linking intracellular metabolic state to cellular behaviour and emergent organisation across scales.
items.summary_zh: PhysiCelldFBA 将单细胞 genome-scale dynamic flux balance analysis 耦合到 PhysiCell 的离格多细胞模拟，并在 E. coli、肿瘤样组织和双物种体系中展示涌现的代谢分层。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本提供跨尺度代谢—空间动力学耦合，并以质量守恒和多类模拟场景检验实现；其生物学结论目前主要来自计算模拟。
items.abstract_zh: 全基因组尺度代谢模型能够预测单个细胞如何分配资源并响应环境，但很少有框架将单细胞代谢与多细胞系统的空间组织联系起来。本文介绍 PhysiCelldFBA，它是 PhysiCell 基于智能体框架的扩展，将全基因组尺度动态通量平衡分析耦合到离格多细胞模拟。每个模拟细胞均携带自身的代谢模型，使局部环境条件塑造代谢，同时代谢活动反馈至周围环境、细胞行为和空间组织。我们首先通过证明在封闭 E. coli 系统中葡萄糖消耗、CO2 产生和生物量积累保持质量平衡来验证该耦合；模拟生物量与解析预测的一致性在 1% 以内。随后，我们展示代谢表型如何在微生物和哺乳动物系统中由这种耦合产生。空间营养梯度在生长中的 E. coli 菌落中产生代谢分层和乙酸交叉供养；扩散受限的代谢在肿瘤样组织中跨广泛代谢物产生增殖区、缺氧区和坏死区；不同的物种特异性代谢网络在双物种联合体中产生互营性交叉供养和空间生态位形成；代谢状态将能量可用性与细胞运动和生长之间的转换耦合。贯穿这些示例，代谢分层、交叉供养和表型适应均由局部代谢优化和环境反馈涌现，而非被显式预设。因此，PhysiCelldFBA 提供了一个通用框架，可在单细胞分辨率模拟全基因组尺度代谢，并将细胞内代谢状态连接至跨尺度的细胞行为和涌现组织。
items.author_line: Hayoun Mya, O., Ruscone, M., Heiland, R., Macklin, P., Valencia, A., Ponce de Leon, M.

items.title: Atlantis: An integrative database for human proteome structural and functional sites
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding protein mechanisms in health and disease requires characterizing the functional roles of individual amino acid residues. To explore the role of residues and their mutations, we have developed Atlantis, a database that integrates structural and functional information at the human proteome residue level. A graph database enables complex queries and the retrieval of integrated information for multiple functional analysis of protein systems. A Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector allows the interrogation of the resource through Large Language Models (LLMs) or agentic frameworks for biomedical research. Atlantis annotates over 11M residues across 20k human proteins, identifying hundreds thousands intra- and inter-protein contacts in PDB as well as AlphaFoldDB structures. We also provide the possibility to analyze and integrate predicted 3D complexes inputted by the user, and we showcased these features on hundreds of AlphaFold-multimer complexes of GPCRs and LRRK2 interaction networks. The tool is freely accessible at https://atlantis.bioinfolab.sns.it/.
items.summary_zh: Atlantis 是一个面向人类蛋白质组残基层面的结构—功能整合数据库，注释超过 20,000 种蛋白中的逾 1,100 万个残基，并提供图数据库、用户复合物分析与 MCP 接口。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 残基层面的结构与功能整合可支撑变异和机制研究；资源的注释准确度、覆盖偏差及外部复现仍应在实际任务中单独评估。
items.abstract_zh: 理解健康和疾病中的蛋白质机制，需要表征单个氨基酸残基的功能作用。为探索残基及其突变的作用，我们开发了 Atlantis：一个在人类蛋白质组残基层面整合结构和功能信息的数据库。图数据库支持复杂查询，并可检索用于蛋白质系统多种功能分析的整合信息。模型上下文协议（MCP）连接器允许通过 Large Language Models（LLMs）或用于生物医学研究的智能体框架查询该资源。Atlantis 注释了 20k 种人类蛋白中的超过 11M 个残基，在 PDB 和 AlphaFoldDB 结构中识别了数十万种蛋白内和蛋白间接触。我们还提供分析和整合用户输入的预测 3D 复合物的可能性，并在数百个 GPCR 的 AlphaFold-multimer 复合物以及 LRRK2 相互作用网络中展示这些功能。该工具可在 https://atlantis.bioinfolab.sns.it/ 免费访问。

items.title: Interpretable Multiomics Machine Learning Identifies GSDMB-Associated Epigenetic Repression and Reduced Immune Activity in Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a major cause of cancer-related mortality, with distant metastasis strongly associated with poor clinical outcomes. Integrating transcriptomic and epigenomic data through machine learning may improve the molecular characterization of metastatic CRC. Methods: We analyzed 518 primary tumors from the TCGA-COAD/READ cohort (436 non-metastatic [M0] and 82 metastatic [M1]) with matched RNA-seq and DNA methylation data. Five machine learning classifiers were evaluated for discrimination of metastatic status using stratified nested cross-validation. Model explainability was assessed using model coefficients for linear classifiers and SHAP-based feature importance for tree-based models. Differential expression, functional enrichment, methylation-expression correlation, immune-related transcriptional scoring, statistical mediation, and survival analyses were subsequently performed. Results: Integrated RNA-seq and DNA methylation showed the strongest discrimination between M0 and M1 tumors, with SVM reaching a ROC-AUC of 0.787 +/- 0.047. Six features - ARC, ASPDH, C13orf15, C4orf23, GPATCH3, and cg12040555 - ranked among the top 20 predictors across four models with consistent directions. cg10057218 methylation was inversely correlated with GSDMB expression (Spearman rho = -0.589) and increased in M1 tumors. Statistical mediation indicated a significant indirect association between M1 status and reduced GSDMB expression through cg10057218 methylation (indirect effect = -0.370; 95% CI [-0.519, -0.224]; proportion mediated = 82.1%). M1 tumors also exhibited reduced immune-related transcriptional activity. A 20-feature canonical molecular score separated M1 from M0 tumors (in-sample ROC-AUC = 0.918), while the corresponding Logistic Regression model achieved a nested cross-validated ROC-AUC of 0.781 +/- 0.046. Higher scores were associated with shorter overall survival (log-rank p = 1.67 x 10^-7). Conclusions: Transcriptomic and DNA methylation integration identified a consistently prioritized multiomics feature set associated with metastatic CRC. The findings highlight coordinated molecular and immune-related differences between M0 and M1 tumors and identify cg10057218-associated GSDMB repression as a candidate epigenetic feature of metastatic disease.

items.abstract_zh: 背景：结直肠癌（CRC）是癌症相关死亡的主要原因，远处转移与不良临床结局密切相关。通过机器学习整合转录组和表观基因组数据，可能改善对转移性 CRC 的分子刻画。方法：我们分析了 TCGA-COAD/READ 队列中 518 个原发肿瘤（436 个非转移性 [M0] 和 82 个转移性 [M1]），这些肿瘤具有匹配的 RNA-seq 和 DNA methylation 数据。采用分层嵌套交叉验证，评估五种机器学习分类器区分转移状态的能力。以线性分类器的模型系数和树模型基于 SHAP 的特征重要性评估模型可解释性。随后进行差异表达、功能富集、甲基化—表达相关、免疫相关转录评分、统计中介和生存分析。结果：整合 RNA-seq 和 DNA methylation 对 M0 与 M1 肿瘤显示出最强区分能力，SVM 的 ROC-AUC 达到 0.787 +/- 0.047。六项特征——ARC、ASPDH、C13orf15、C4orf23、GPATCH3 和 cg12040555——在四个模型中均以一致方向位列前 20 个预测因子。cg10057218 甲基化与 GSDMB 表达负相关（Spearman rho = -0.589），且在 M1 肿瘤中增加。统计中介分析显示，M1 状态与经由 cg10057218 甲基化导致的 GSDMB 表达降低之间存在显著间接关联（间接效应 = -0.370；95% CI [-0.519, -0.224]；中介比例 = 82.1%）。M1 肿瘤也呈现降低的免疫相关转录活性。一个 20 特征标准分子评分区分 M1 与 M0 肿瘤（样本内 ROC-AUC = 0.918），而相应的 Logistic Regression 模型达到嵌套交叉验证 ROC-AUC = 0.781 +/- 0.046。较高评分与较短总生存期相关（log-rank p = 1.67 x 10^-7）。结论：转录组和 DNA methylation 的整合确定了一组被一致优先识别的多组学特征，它们与转移性 CRC 相关。这些发现突出了 M0 与 M1 肿瘤之间协调的分子和免疫相关差异，并将与 cg10057218 相关的 GSDMB 抑制确定为转移性疾病的候选表观遗传特征。

items.title: Comparative Evaluation of Pathology Foundation Models and Transcriptomic Integration for Glioblastoma Survival Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Glioblastoma Multiforme (GBM) is a highly aggressive glioma difficult to stratify prognostically. Whole-slide histopathology images (WSIs) and RNA-seq profiles capture complementary phenotypic and molecular characteristics, yet their individual and combined value for GBM-specific survival prediction remains insufficiently characterized. Despite the promise of recent pathology foundation models to provide richer and more transferable image representations, their added prognostic value in GBM, either alone or in combination with transcriptomic data, has not yet been established. To address these gaps, this study evaluated deep survival models based on WSIs, RNA-seq data, and their integration for overall survival prediction in the TCGA-GBM cohort. WSI representations were derived by means of a general-domain ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 as a baseline, and five recent histopathology-specific foundation-model configurations. To disentangle modality effects from differences in sample size, models were evaluated in both full and size-matched cohorts. Results Under size-matched conditions, multimodal integration consistently improved performance over WSI-only modelling across all six WSI encoders, despite the use of state-of-the-art pathology foundation models. Multimodal models achieved median C-indexes of 0.614–0.698, with a significant overall effect of modality. The CONCH-v1.5-based multimodal model achieved the highest median C-index of 0.698. RNA-seq provided the strongest prognostic signal, with held-out median C-indexes of 0.629 and 0.632 under full-budget and size-matched training, respectively. WSI-only models achieved median C-indexes of 0.543– 0.587 under full-budget training and 0.512–0.549 under size-matched training. In this limited-size cohort and frozen-weight setting, WSI encoder choice did not significantly affect full-budget unimodal performance, and pathology foundation models did not systematically outperform the ResNet50 baseline. Overall, results suggest a positive but unconfirmed trend towards additional prognostic value in GBM from integrating histopathological and transcriptomic features. Conclusions In this limited-size, frozen-encoder setting, integrating WSI and RNA-seq improved performance over WSI-only modelling across all encoders. The CONCH-v1.5-based multimodal model achieved the highest overall performance, while multimodal integration showed a positive but unconfirmed trend over RNA-seq alone. Pathology foundation models did not provide a consistent prognostic advantage over the ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 baseline. Larger independent cohorts are needed to confirm the incremental value of multimodal integration.

items.abstract_zh: 背景：胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）是一种高度侵袭性的胶质瘤，难以进行预后分层。全切片组织病理图像（WSIs）和 RNA-seq 图谱捕捉互补的表型和分子特征，但它们各自及联合用于 GBM 特异性生存预测的价值仍缺乏充分表征。尽管近期病理基础模型有望提供更丰富、更可迁移的图像表征，但其在 GBM 中单独使用或与转录组数据结合后的额外预后价值尚未建立。为填补这些空白，本研究在 TCGA-GBM 队列中评估了基于 WSI、RNA-seq 数据及其整合的总体生存深度模型。WSI 表征来自作为基线的通用领域 ImageNet 预训练 ResNet50，以及五种近期病理特异性基础模型配置。为将模态效应与样本量差异分离，模型同时在完整队列和样本量匹配队列中进行评估。结果：在样本量匹配条件下，无论采用六种 WSI 编码器中的哪一种，多模态整合相对 WSI-only 建模均一致改善表现，尽管使用了最先进的病理基础模型。多模态模型的中位 C-index 为 0.614–0.698，模态具有显著的总体效应。基于 CONCH-v1.5 的多模态模型达到最高的中位 C-index 0.698。RNA-seq 提供最强的预后信号，在完整预算和样本量匹配训练下，留出集的中位 C-index 分别为 0.629 和 0.632。WSI-only 模型在完整预算训练下的中位 C-index 为 0.543–0.587，在样本量匹配训练下为 0.512–0.549。在这一有限样本、冻结权重的设置中，WSI 编码器选择并未显著影响完整预算的单模态表现，病理基础模型也未系统性优于 ImageNet 预训练 ResNet50 基线。总体而言，结果提示整合组织病理和转录组特征可能为 GBM 带来额外的正向预后价值，但这一趋势尚未得到确认。结论：在这一有限样本、冻结编码器的设置中，整合 WSI 和 RNA-seq 相较所有编码器的 WSI-only 建模均改善表现。基于 CONCH-v1.5 的多模态模型达到最高总体表现，而多模态整合相对单独 RNA-seq 显示出尚未确认的正向趋势。病理基础模型没有提供相对于 ImageNet 预训练 ResNet50 一致的预后优势。需要更大的独立队列确认多模态整合的增量价值。

items.title: LGTM: Gaussian Process Modulated Neural Topic Modeling for Longitudinal Microbiome
items.abstract_or_text: Longitudinal microbiome data are key to understanding the dynamics of microbial communities and their relationships with the host and environment. However, analysis of such data is challenging due to high dimensionality, compositionality, irregular sampling and temporal dependencies on external covariates. Existing analytical approaches typically address only subsets of these challenges, limiting their ability to yield biologically interpretable insights. We introduce LGTM, a probabilistic modeling framework that combines flexible non-linear longitudinal modeling with interpretable topic-based representations of the microbiome. LGTM simultaneously identifies microbial co-abundance patterns ("topics") and models how their proportions change over time and in relation to host and environmental covariates. Using multiple longitudinal human gut microbiome datasets, we demonstrate that LGTM identifies diverse microbial topics whose major patterns are reproducible across runs, while achieving competitive performance in imputation and forecasting tasks. A key strength of the framework is its interpretability: LGTM yields microbial topics with biologically interpretable taxonomic compositions and directly quantifies associations between covariates and microbial dynamics. LGTM is available at https://github.com/yuanx749/lgtm.
items.summary_zh: LGTM 以 Gaussian Process 调制的神经主题模型联合学习纵向微生物共丰度主题及其与宿主、环境协变量的非线性时间关系，并公开 GitHub 实现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法同时处理纵向微生物组的组成性、不规则采样和解释性问题；论文报告的插补与预测竞争力仍应在未见队列和具体生物学问题中复核。
items.abstract_zh: 纵向微生物组数据是理解微生物群落动态及其与宿主和环境关系的关键。然而，由于高维性、组成性、不规则采样以及对外部协变量的时间依赖性，此类数据的分析具有挑战。现有分析方法通常只处理其中部分挑战，限制了其产生具有生物学可解释性见解的能力。我们引入 LGTM：一个概率建模框架，将灵活的非线性纵向建模与基于主题、可解释的微生物组表征相结合。LGTM 同时识别微生物共丰度模式（“主题”），并模拟其比例如何随时间以及随宿主和环境协变量而变化。利用多个纵向人类肠道微生物组数据集，我们表明 LGTM 能识别多样的微生物主题，其主要模式在不同运行间可重复，同时在插补和预测任务中取得有竞争力的表现。该框架的一项关键优势是可解释性：LGTM 产生具有生物学可解释分类组成的微生物主题，并直接量化协变量与微生物动态之间的关联。LGTM 可在 https://github.com/yuanx749/lgtm 获取。

items.title: How thermostable direct haemolysin (TDH) diverges from TDH-related haemolysin (TRH)? Reassessing haemolysins in Vibrio parahaemolyticus through functional and structural representation learning
items.abstract_or_text: Vibrio parahaemolyticus (Vp) is the major foodborne pathogen transmitted via shellfish products, which has posed significant threats to modern public health and resulted in significant economic damage to the seafood industry. Numerous studies have documented diverse aspects of Vp pathogenicity, among which thermostable direct haemolysin (TDH) and TDH related haemolysin (TRH) are considered as the major virulence biomarkers of Vp. Despite their established roles as key biomarkers, a systematic understanding of the divergence of TDH and TRH across sequence, structure, and function remains limited. In this study, a multi scale analysis of TDH and TRH was performed using publicly available (2131 and 99 records from NCBI and Uniprot database, respectively) amino acid sequence data combined with representation learning and structure prediction. Global alignment of curated TDH and TRH sequences revealed extensive, distributed mutations and clear separation between TDH and TRH at the amino acid level (percentage identity of between TDH and TRH ranging from 56.1 to 67.4%). In contrast, protein language model derived embeddings showed high global functional similarity while preserving distinct clustering patterns, indicating conserved core functionality alongside nuanced divergence echoed with the structural inference by AlphaFold. Importantly, modeling of mutation trajectories demonstrated that the transition from TDH to TRH is driven by accumulated, genome-wide residue changes rather than a small set of key mutations. Together, these results suggested that TDH and TRH represent functionally conserved yet evolutionarily diverged toxins driven by accumulated sequence variation throughout the full-length amino acid sequence. These accumulated point mutations lead to major structural difference: TRH forms an alpha-helical tail that TDH lacks, which suggests that TDH and TRH disrupt host membranes by different mechanisms despite their conserved core function, such as pore-forming and ion flux induction capability. These methods provided unprecedented detailed insights into the functional and structural properties of Vp haemolysin, offering critical information on how multi-dimensional variations in sequence might influence their role in Vp pathogenicity. Insights from this study reinforce the rationale for using Vp strains harboring tdh and trh genes in experimental design for environmental fitness investigation.

items.abstract_zh: 副溶血性弧菌（Vibrio parahaemolyticus，Vp）是经贝类产品传播的主要食源性病原体，对现代公共卫生构成显著威胁，并给海产品产业造成重大经济损失。大量研究已记载 Vp 致病性的不同方面，其中耐热直接溶血素（TDH）和 TDH-related haemolysin（TRH）被视为 Vp 的主要毒力生物标志物。尽管它们作为关键生物标志物的作用已经确立，但对 TDH 与 TRH 在序列、结构和功能层面分化的系统理解仍然有限。本研究将公开可得的氨基酸序列数据与表征学习和结构预测相结合，对 TDH 和 TRH 进行多尺度分析；这些数据包括分别来自 NCBI 和 Uniprot 数据库的 2131 条和 99 条记录。对经整理的 TDH 和 TRH 序列进行全局比对，显示广泛、分散的突变以及二者在氨基酸层面的清晰分离（TDH 与 TRH 间的序列一致性范围为 56.1 至 67.4%）。相反，蛋白语言模型导出的嵌入显示出较高的整体功能相似性，同时保留了不同的聚类模式；这表明二者保持保守核心功能的同时存在细微分化，且与 AlphaFold 的结构推断相呼应。重要的是，对突变轨迹的建模表明，从 TDH 到 TRH 的转变由累积的、遍及全基因组的残基改变驱动，而不是由少数关键突变驱动。总之，这些结果提示 TDH 和 TRH 是功能上保守、但在进化上分化的毒素；这种分化由全长氨基酸序列中累积的变异驱动。这些累积点突变导致主要结构差异：TRH 形成 TDH 所缺乏的 alpha-helical tail；这提示尽管二者保留了诸如孔形成和诱导离子通量的核心功能，TDH 和 TRH 可能以不同机制破坏宿主膜。这些方法为 Vp 溶血素的功能和结构性质提供了前所未有的详细见解，并为序列的多维变异如何影响其在 Vp 致病性中的作用提供关键信息。本研究的见解强化了在环境适应性研究的实验设计中使用携带 tdh 和 trh 基因的 Vp 菌株的理由。

items.abstract_or_text: GPT-6 Astra has set a new ECI record, with a score of 169. This is a substantial jump from the prior best (163), but is within our uncertainty range for the reasoning-era ECI trend. Astra also set new records on our math, continual learning, and game-puzzles benchmarks. On our long-horizon coding benchmark, MirrorCode, Astra ranks between Opus 4.7 and Fable 5. OpenAI gave us pre-release access to test Astra. Charts and more details for Astra’s individual benchmark results in the thread.

items.abstract_or_text: models : fix GDN normalization from `max` to `rsqrt` (#28068) * models: use flash-linear-attention's l2norm for gated delta net q/k The GDN q/k normalization is defined by flash-linear-attention as l2norm(x) = x * rsqrt(sum(x*x) + eps) with eps inside the root. Every GDN call site in the tree uses ggml_l2_norm instead, which is x / max(sqrt(sum(x*x)), eps), i.e. torch.nn.functional.normalize - its CUDA kernel cites that page. The clamp never engages at these magnitudes, so in practice llama.cpp…
items.summary_zh: ggml-org/llama.cpp 发布预发布版本 b10829，修正 Gated Delta Net 的 Q/K 归一化实现：由基于 max 的形式改为与 flash-linear-attention 参考实现一致的 rsqrt 形式。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是影响特定 GDN 模型推理数值正确性的底层修复，适合部署相关模型或维护 llama.cpp 推理栈的开发者关注。该版本为 prerelease，候选未提供端到端性能或回归结果；升级前应以目标模型和硬件完成输出一致性及性能验证。
items.abstract_zh: 模型修复：将 GDN 归一化从 max 改为 rsqrt。更新采用 flash-linear-attention 中带根号内 epsilon 的 l2norm，用于 Gated Delta Net 的 Q/K 归一化，以修正与参考实现的差异。
